notes: Four tabs: To review, In flight, Owned, and Archive. The app opens on To review, and each tab shows a count.
To review: open a property and tap Keep to move it to In flight, or Remove and pick a reason to archive it.
In flight: each deal has a stage (Interested, Inquired, Toured, Offer made, Under contract). Mark as bought moves it to Owned.
Owned: enter each property's value, mortgage balance, rent and costs to see equity and net rental income, with totals. These figures stay on your device.
Archive: removed properties and lost deals with the reason and date. Move one back to review, or delete it for good.
New DealDesk logo, and an app icon for your phone's home screen.
The page now always uses the light theme, even when your phone is in dark mode.
On a phone, the pipeline now shows the four columns that decide a deal (property, asking price, maximum offer, verdict) with no sideways scrolling. Tap a deal for the rest.
First release. Scores rental deals against your buy box and works each one back to a maximum offer.
Starts with 16 listings from Manchester and Nashua, NH.
Works on your phone. New listings added to the repo show up the next time you open the page.
